jobs.title: VP, Finance Excellence and Transformation
jobs.description:
VP, Finance Excellence and Transformation
Amentum is a global leader in advanced engineering and innovative technology solutions, trusted by the United States and its allies to address their most significant and complex challenges in science, security and sustainability. Our people apply undaunted curiosity, relentless ambition and boundless imagination to challenge convention and drive progress. Our commitments are underpinned by the belief that safety, collaboration and well-being are integral to success. Headquartered in Reston, Virginia, we have approximately 50,000 employees in more than 70 countries across all 7 continents.

Job Summary
Amentum is seeking an experienced and strategic Vice President of Finance Excellence and Transformation to lead a technology centric enterprise-wide Finance transformation.  Following a period of rapid growth through multiple acquisitions and integrations this position will play a critical role in unifying our finance landscape and creating a scalable, integrated future-state operating model that supports Amentum’s long-term profitable growth objectives.

Partnering with the entire CFO leadership team and key stakeholders across other enterprise functions and operations, a primary objective of this role is to design and deliver a multi-year transformation roadmap that leverages technology to strengthen our processes, systems, data, and governance.

Reporting to the Senior Vice President, Enterprise Finance, this position is part of Amentum’s Finance organization. We prefer a candidate local to Reston, VA but we will consider remote-telework candidates. US Citizenship is required.

Key Responsibilities:
- Developing the Transformation Vision: Collaborate with CFO leadership team to create a compelling, well-defined finance transformation vision that aligns with the broader organizational strategy and identifies opportunities for value creation.
- Stakeholder Engagement: Establish a stakeholder management strategy to secure buy-in and support from key stakeholders. This includes engaging with business leaders early in the process to foster collaboration and address concerns.
- Change Management: Partner closely with Finance, Contracts, IT, HR, and Operations leaders on effective change management while harmonizing processes and ensuring alignment and adoption of new tools and standards.
- Assess current-state processes, systems, legacy platforms, and organizational structures to identify gaps, inefficiencies, and integration challenges related to our M&A-driven growth.
- Lead the end-to-end strategy, planning, and execution of an enterprise-wide finance transformation program.
- Coordinate and oversee day-to-day activities across project phases, including scope definition, dependency management, resource allocation, and milestone tracking.
- Drive continuous improvement and modernization initiatives including financial system automation, data governance, and reporting enhancements.
- Set and track key performance indicators (KPIs) that measure the success of transformation initiatives. Regularly review KPI’s with leadership to communicate program updates, risks, mitigation plans and need to adapt strategies if applicable.
- Manage diverse stakeholder groups to drive initiatives impacting a variety of end-to-end processes including, but not limited to, Hire-to-Retire (H2R), Procure-to-Pay (P2P), Order-to-Cash (O2C), and Record-to-Report (R2R).
- Oversee cross-functional project teams, external consultants, and technology vendors.

Knowledge, Skills and Abilities:
- Data-driven and continuous learning mindset — Candidates should demonstrate curiosity, adaptability, and the ability to learn new technologies quickly, including leveraging AI to automate repetitive tasks, synthesize information, improve communication, and accelerate problem solving while maintaining human judgment and accountability.
- Ability to evaluate and apply emerging technologies — Candidates should be comfortable assessing new AI-enabled tools and processes, identifying practical use cases, validating outputs, understanding limitations/risk, and incorporating AI responsibly into day-to-day work.
- Demonstrated AI fluency and workflow integration — Candidates should have experience using AI tools to enhance workflows, productivity, decision-making, customer experiences, business outcomes, or operational efficiency.
- Strong understanding of government contracting financial requirements, including FAR, CAS, indirect rate structures, and audit readiness.
- Experience driving multi-phase cross-functional projects involving ERP systems, adjacent functional systems, process automation, and data/reporting modernization.
- Strong executive communication skills and experience presenting to C-suite stakeholders, to include storytelling capabilities to convey the transformation vision effectively to diverse audiences.
- Demonstrated ability to lead cross-functional teams, manage complex change, and influence without direct authority.
- Demonstrated experience creating governance frameworks, KPIs, and transformation performance metrics.
- Strong understanding of advanced digital technologies and their application in finance operations with the ability to leverage technology to enhance efficiency and accuracy.
- Strong skills in relationship-building and conflict resolution to engage stakeholders and address resistance effectively.
- Ability to define strategic objectives aligned with corporate goals and lead the team towards achieving these objectives through a structured approach.
- Demonstrated program leadership and execution to lead cross-functional finance transformation projects spanning process standardization, automation, and data integrity.
- Continuous improvement mindset focused on learning from past initiatives to refine future strategies is paramount for success in this role.
- Adaptive to changes in business priorities and capable of adjusting the transformation strategy as the organization evolves.

Minimum Qualifications:
- Typically 12–15+ years of progressive experience in Finance, Program Finance, or Financial Operations, with at least 5 years leading enterprise-wide finance transformation initiatives.
- Bachelor’s degree in finance, accounting, business, or related field; master’s degree is preferred.
- Proven track record of leading finance teams and managing transformation projects with proven success managing post-M&A financial process integration, legacy system consolidation, and data harmonization in a complex Govcon environment.
- US Citizenship is required to apply.

The Finance Manager will lead financial planning, analysis, and reporting for large-scale Space Force programs. Purpose and Impact:

We are seeking an experienced and data-driven Program Manager to lead a multidisciplinary team of analysts and engineers supporting a client’s performance measurement program.

The Program Manager – Data Analytics will serve as the primary point of contact for the Government, providing overall leadership, direction, and oversight for all contractor personnel. This role ensures the successful execution of program tasks, delivery of high-quality outputs, and expert support across performance management, business analytics, and technical domains.

Additionally, the Program Manager will act as the key liaison to the Contracting Officer’s Technical Representative (COTR), managing all contract-related matters, including cost, schedule, and overall performance.

Work Schedule: M-F, 40 hours/week (Flex time, Comp time, and Extended Work Week (EWW) approved)

Essential Responsibilities:

- Plan, direct, and schedule the timely and successful completion of the work on the contract.
- Monitor program performance regularly for conformance to original program scope and maintain continual reviews to ensure that all terms and conditions are met in accordance with legal requirements, customer specifications, and government regulations.
- Maintain on-going coordination with contract support team to ensure timely and accurate completion and/or delivery of monthly and as-needed program requirements.
- Prepare and disseminate Monthly Contract Status Report (MCSR) to the client regarding contract status, compliance, satisfaction, and limitations.
- Serve as the single focal point to the COTR for managing all tasks and subtasks.
- As Principal Representative for project direction, provide the COTR and CO with information and solutions regarding significant issues that will have a direct impact on the contract.

- Provide daily oversight and management of personnel contract hours including but not limited to timecard submittal, review, approval, reconciliation, troubleshooting, and resolution of discrepancies.

- Conduct bi-weekly workstream review and planning meetings with all personnel assigned to the contract.

- Engage regularly with staff to identify organizational gaps and opportunities.
- Gather program/project requirements and evaluate, analyze, and propose operational and technical solutions.

The work environment is fast-paced and sometimes involves extreme deadline pressures. The nature of the work requires a high degree of teamwork and cooperation with other members of the staff as well as individuals across the Company and Customers.

Attendance is critical at all times. Must be able to work a 40-hour workweek, normally Monday through Friday.  However, times and days may vary depending on business requirements. Needs to be available to work overtime during critical peaks and be available to meet last minute requests for overtime should the situation occur.

Must be able to communicate effectively both verbally and in writing
Grooming and dress must be appropriate for the position and must not impose a safety risk/hazard to the employee or others. Must put forward a professional behavior that enhances productivity and promotes teamwork and cooperation.

Must be able to interface with individuals at all levels of the organization both verbally and in writing. Must be well-organized with the ability to coordinate and prioritize multiple tasks simultaneously. Must work well under pressure to meet deadline requirements. Must be willing to travel as needed. jobs.description:
At Amentum, we're not just solving problems; we're engineering the future. Our team is driven by an unyielding commitment to innovation, integrity, and collaboration, tackling some of the most significant challenges in science, security, and sustainability. If you're passionate about making a real impact and want to be part of a community that values ethical excellence, this is the place where your ambition can thrive.

Here, we believe that success comes from continuously pushing boundaries and working together to deliver on our promises. We embrace challenges with confidence and are dedicated to creating a secure and vibrant future for all.

We’ll inspire and empower you to deliver your best work so you can evolve, grow and succeed – today and into tomorrow.  We offer an exciting range of opportunities to develop your career within a supportive team who always strive to do the right thing for our people, clients and communities.

People are our greatest asset, and we offer a competitive package to retain and attract the best talent.

In addition to the benefits you’d expect, UK employees also receive free single medical cover and digital GP service, family-friendly benefits such as enhanced parental leave pay and free membership of employee assistance and parental programmes, plus reimbursement towards relevant professional development and memberships.

Work-life balance and flexibility is a key focus area for us. We’re happy to discuss hybrid, part-time and flexible working hours, patterns and locations to suit you and our business.

This role can be based in Harwell, Bristol, Rotherham, Cumbria or Warrington.

About the Opportunity

We are looking for an experienced environmental professional to join our Earth & Environmental Services business as Deputy Operations Manager – Environmental Services . Working directly with the Operations Manager, you will take a leading role in the management, technical governance, commercial performance and strategic development of our environmental capability, encompassing three established teams:

- Land Quality;
- EIA and Planning; and
- Environmental Advisory & Permitting.

This is a senior leadership position combining environmental technical expertise with people leadership, commercial management and business development. You will work closely with the Operations Manager and the leaders of each environmental team to ensure that we maintain high technical standards, deliver successfully for our clients and continue to develop and grow our environmental capability.

You will provide line management and support to the three environmental Team Leaders, helping them to manage, develop and grow their respective teams. You will also play an important role in integrating our environmental services with the wider capabilities of Earth & Environmental Services and the broader Amentum business, supporting the delivery of genuinely multidisciplinary projects.

We are looking for someone with an established technical background in one or more of our environmental disciplines. You do not need to be a technical specialist across all three areas, but you will need sufficient environmental breadth, curiosity and leadership capability to understand, support and develop each discipline and to recognise where specialist technical input is required.

This represents an opportunity for an established environmental professional to broaden their career beyond technical delivery into operational and commercial leadership, while remaining closely connected to technical practice and project delivery.

Candidates will be able to demonstrate a substantial track record across the following key responsibilities, though we understand that not everyone will meet every requirement.

- Operational Leadership: Support the Operations Manager in the day-to-day leadership and management of the environmental teams, helping to manage workload, resources, priorities and performance across the business area.
- Technical Governance: Provide leadership and oversight of technical governance across Land Quality, EIA and Planning, and Environmental Advisory & Permitting. Work with Team Leaders and technical specialists to maintain appropriate standards of technical quality, assurance and professional practice.
- Commercial Management: Take a leading role in the commercial management of the environmental portfolio, supporting project performance, forecasting, resource management and appropriate management of commercial and delivery risk.
- Bid Leadership: Lead and coordinate bids and proposals for environmental and multidisciplinary opportunities, bringing together technical, commercial and project management inputs to develop competitive and deliverable solutions for our clients.
- Business Development & Strategic Growth: Work with the Operations Manager, Team Leaders and wider Amentum business to identify and develop opportunities for strategic growth, including development of existing services, new capabilities, client relationships and opportunities to enter new markets.
- People Leadership: Provide line management to the environmental Team Leaders and support them in the effective management, development and mentoring of their teams. Help develop succession, career pathways and future technical and leadership capability.
- Recruitment & Capability Development: Lead and support recruitment across the environmental teams, identifying capability and resource requirements and helping to build teams aligned with current workload and future strategic needs.
- Multidisciplinary Integration: Develop strong working relationships across Earth & Environmental Services and the wider Amentum business, integrating environmental capability with disciplines including geoscience, geotechnical engineering, hydrogeology, geophysics and geospatial services, as well as wider engineering and programme capabilities.
- Project & Client Delivery: Support the successful delivery of complex environmental and multidisciplinary projects, providing senior technical and commercial oversight where appropriate and developing trusted relationships with key clients.
- Health & Safety Compliance: Working with your peers, manage adherence to Amentum’s HSE requirements, both on-site and in office environments, ensuring you and your colleagues maintain safe working conditions.
- Professional Development: Maintain and develop your own professional and technical knowledge while actively supporting the development, mentoring and progression of others.

Suitable candidates are likely to have the following qualifications and experience, though again we understand that not everyone will meet every single requirement.

- Education: Bachelor’s degree (or higher) in Environmental Science, Environmental Engineering, Geoscience, Planning or another relevant environmental discipline. A Master’s degree is advantageous but not essential.
- Professional Experience: Substantial experience within environmental consultancy, engineering consultancy or a related environmental profession, including experience operating at a senior technical, team leadership or management level.
- Technical Expertise: Established technical expertise in one or more of Land Quality/contaminated land, EIA and Planning, or Environmental Advisory & Permitting, combined with sufficient breadth and interest to provide effective leadership across the wider environmental portfolio.
- Professional Recognition: Chartered status or equivalent professional recognition through an appropriate professional body is desirable.
- Commercial Awareness: Experience of managing the commercial aspects of consultancy work, including project performance, resourcing, forecasting, scope and change management and management of delivery risk.
- Bid & Business Development Experience: Demonstrable experience of developing and leading successful proposals and contributing to client development and business growth.
- Leadership & People Management: Experience of leading and developing technical professionals, with the ability to support Team Leaders in managing performance, career development, recruitment and succession.
- Technical Governance: An understanding of technical assurance, quality management and the governance required to deliver high-quality environmental consultancy services, particularly within complex or highly regulated environments.
- Teamwork & Communication: Excellent written and verbal communication skills and the ability to work effectively across technical disciplines, projects, clients and different parts of a large organisation.
- Strategic Mindset: The ability to look beyond immediate project delivery and contribute to longer-term capability development, recruitment, market positioning and strategic growth.
- Motivation & Growth Mindset: An enthusiasm to develop both our people and our business, with the flexibility to work across disciplines and willingness to travel to project and client locations where required.
- Other: A valid UK driving licence (or ability to obtain one in the near future) is beneficial.

Our Culture

Our values are built on a strong foundation of safety, integrity, and respect for every individual. People are at the heart of our mission, and we believe in supporting one another through a culture of care and collaboration.

We strive to create a workplace where everyone feels they belong and can thrive. Supporting mental wellbeing and fostering a sense of connection are essential to how we work.

When we embrace different perspectives and work together, we become more innovative, more agile, and more successful.

We welcome applications from candidates who are seeking flexible working and from those who may not meet all the listed requirements for a role.

The Analyst leads wastewater-based epidemiology and integrates public health, biosurveillance, wastewater, open-source, operational, and classified information to identify anomalies and assess force-health and mission effects. General public health experience without applied epidemiological or biosurveillance expertise is insufficient. jobs.description:
Amentum is seeking a driven and professional Medical Intelligence Operations Analyst to work on the US PACOM Command Surgeon’s Decision Support Team (DST). This position serves as the DST's senior medical-intelligence specialist and primary interface with the US PACOM J2 intelligence enterprise regarding biosurveillence and related threats. The Analyst assesses foreign medical capabilities, emerging diseases, biological threats, biosecurity, biosafety, and related scientific developments. General all-source experience without medical-intelligence expertise is insufficient. Assigned to the PACOM Joint Intelligence Operations Center (JIOC), the position directly supports Command Surgeon (J07), receives functional priorities from J07 through established contract channels, operates with project and technical oversight from Science and Technology Division (S&T) - J85, and reports administratively to the Amentum Project Lead.

Essential Responsibilities :
- Conduct medical-intelligence analysis of worldwide health, medical, biological, biosecurity, and biosafety issues affecting the US PACOM AOR.
- Assess foreign medical capabilities, emerging diseases, biological warfare and bioterrorism threats, medical research, and scientific or technological developments.
- Fuse classified intelligence, medical reporting, scientific research, public-health data, open sources, and partner reporting.
- Identify indicators, trends, anomalies, intelligence gaps, and implications for force health, readiness, and mission risk.
- Maintain awareness of US PACOM plans and operations; assess and forecast medical-intelligence implications for current and anticipated missions.
- Serve as the DST interface with J2, DIA, the National Center for Medical Intelligence, and other Intelligence Community organizations.
- Produce assessments and briefings consistent with analytic standards, classification requirements, and dissemination controls.
- Provide findings to the Operations Planner for integration with epidemiology, Chemical, Biological, Radiological, Nuclear, and Explosive (CBRNE) analysis, Force Health Protection, and operational plans.
- Participate in intelligence exchanges, working groups, exercises, and bilateral or multilateral biosurveillance activities.
- Test the Biosurveillance Information Platform and provide intelligence-specific findings for Military Utility Assessments and recommendations.
- Translate intelligence-user needs into requirements for technical feeds, dashboards, alerts, and workflows; coding is not required.

Minimum Requirements:
- Bachelor of Science or Bachelor of Arts degree, or equivalent education, intelligence training, military education, and directly related experience.

- Active TS/SCI clearance and ability to complete a polygraph examination if required. Note:  US Citizenship is required to obtain a Top-Secret Clearance.

- Minimum 8 years of progressively responsible intelligence analysis, including at least 2 years conducting medical intelligence analysis.
- Medical-intelligence experience involving health threats, foreign medical capabilities, emerging diseases, biological threats, or scientific and technical intelligence.
- Working knowledge of DIA analytic tradecraft, product standards, and style requirements and Intelligence Community Directives 203 and 206.
- Ability to fuse medical, scientific, and intelligence information into products suitable for senior Department of War (DoW) leaders.
- Familiarity with military planning and ability to work with military planners; strong analytic writing, briefing, and classified-information handling skills.

Preferred Qualifications:
- Advanced Degree.
- Medical-intelligence experience within the last 5 years; Military Intelligence Integrated Database (MIDB)/Machine-Assisted Analytic Rapid-Repository System (MARS) or comparable database experience.
- Education or professional experience in medicine, biology, epidemiology, public health, microbiology, or another health field.
- Combatant Command, JIOC, DIA, National Center for Medical Intelligence (NCMI), biosafety, or biological-research-facility experience.
- Indo-Pacific experience and familiarity with AI-enabled tools, Maven Smart System, or biosurveillance platforms.
- Deep understanding of global infectious diseases, endemic pathogens, biosafety/biosecurity standards (BSL-3/BSL-4), and emerging dual-use biotechnology.
- Thorough knowledge of State/Non-State biological warfare (BW) doctrine, weaponization methods, and bioterrorism threat vectors.

- Mastery of ICD 203 (Analytic Standards) and ICD 206 (Sourcing Requirements & Dissemination).
- Familiarity with the National Center for Medical Intelligence (NCMI) operations, reporting workflows, and production frameworks.
- Working knowledge of Joint Staff and Combatant Command (CCMD) intelligence directorate structures (specifically J2, J3/JOC, J07, and J85).
- Working knowledge of public health infrastructure, endemic disease landscapes, and biosecurity policies across the Indo-Pacific Area of Responsibility (AOR).

jobs.title: Cyber Intelligence Operations Analyst
jobs.description:
Amentum has an opportunity for a highly qualified Cyber Intelligence Operations Analyst to play a pivotal role in providing actionable intelligence to support cyber operations. This position demands a keen understanding of cyber threats, trends, and tactics, as well as the ability to analyze and synthesize complex data from various sources. This position requires understanding and execution of intelligence support to offensive cyberspace operations. The analyst will collaborate closely with cyber operations teams to identify, assess, and mitigate cyber risks, ensuring the protection and resilience of critical network infrastructure. ​​

Utilizing established analytical tradecraft and Department of War Intelligence Cycle gathers and analyzes all data which provides intelligence support to cyberspace operations. Support will span full-spectrum (offense and defense) cyberspace operations and will enable: planning; target system analysis; collection management; coordination of intelligence community production; intelligence gap analysis; adversary tactics, techniques, and procedures; threat analysis of Mission Relevant Terrain – Cyber or Cyber Key Terrain; target development; and intelligence requirements development.

Duties and Responsibilities:
- Conduct in-depth analysis of cyber threat intelligence, including emerging malware, vulnerabilities, and attack vectors.
- Collect, evaluate, and fuse intelligence from diverse sources, including open-source intelligence (OSINT), signals intelligence (SIGINT), human intelligence (HUMINT), and technical intelligence (TECHINT). Identify correlations and patterns to enhance situational awareness and predictive analysis.
- Assess the potential impact of cyber threats on network infrastructure and operations. Collaborate with cyber defense teams to develop and implement mitigation strategies and countermeasures.
- Provide intelligence support during cyber incident response activities, including analysis of indicators of compromise (IOCs), attribution of cyber-attacks, and identification of adversary tactics, techniques, and procedures (TTPs).
- Prepare and deliver clear and concise intelligence products, including reports, briefings, and presentations, for a diverse audience, including senior leadership, operational stakeholders, and technical teams.
- Foster collaboration and information sharing with internal and external stakeholders, including other intelligence agencies, law enforcement, industry partners, and allied nations, to enhance cyber threat awareness and response capabilities.
- Stay abreast of emerging cyber threats, technologies, and methodologies through continuous research and professional development. Contribute to the development of new analytical techniques, tools, and processes to improve intelligence analysis and cyber defense capabilities.
- Conduct target system analysis to support entity of interest for offensive cyberspace operations, coordinate for intelligence production and analysis to support advance technical development for offensive operations.
- Execute collection management drawing subordinate unit intelligence requirements and overseeing their progress through the various means of collection to resolve intelligence gaps.
- Develop Targets through Advanced Target development to achieve vetted and validated COCOM level targets for mission package execution.
- Maintain various mission profile intelligence documentation requirements to support execution offensive cyberspace operations.
- Conduct Mission Analysis process and know and be able to support intelligence preparation of the battlespace to support operational planning and entity of interest development for further technical analysis.
- This position may require up to 10% travel.

Minimum Requirements:
- Bachelor’s degree in computer science, Information Security, Cybersecurity, Intelligence/International Studies, or related field.
- Minimum of 4 years of experience in intelligence analysis with a focus on cyber threats or operations.
- Proficiency in intelligence analysis tools and techniques, such as data visualization, link analysis, and threat modeling.
- Familiarity with Intelligence inputs to MDMP, JPP, and the Joint Targeting Cycle
- Must have an active Top-Secret Clearance with SCI Eligibility and current CI Polygraph. Note: U.S. Citizenship is required to obtain a Top-Secret Clearance.

Proactively coordinate with all ASC departments as needed to facilitate and complete all sustaining and project needs of the United States Antarctic Program. Physically support teams as needed with equipment operation and on-site guidance.

- Communicates professionally, both orally and in writing, with the National Science Foundation, station management, other contractors, and subordinates as needed to coordinate efficient and effective use of all Fleet Operations personnel and equipment.

- Complies with and ensures all team members understand and comply with ASC Environmental Health & Safety and Quality Assurance requirements and goals and provides documentation to these divisions as necessary.

- Reports and documents incidents in a timely manner.
